name: thesvg
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：thesvg。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Fetch brand SVG logos and cloud architecture icons (AWS, Azure, GCP) from theSVG. Use when the user asks for a brand logo, company icon, framework mark, service icon, or any "icon/logo for X" where X is a real brand or cloud service. Returns ready-to-use CDN URLs or raw SVG markup.
unshelve_reason: 问二 · 作者自家图标库的取货指针：正文核心内容就是一条 jsDelivr URL 模板加 slug 命名规则，末尾还挂着 Figma 插件、VS Code 扩展、Raycast、MCP server 四个自家入口。品牌 logo 和云服务图标属通用开发件，用户在 simple-icons、svgl 等处随手可得；对我们的读者没有增量。 正文原话：「theSVG hosts 6,500+ brand SVGs and cloud architecture icons under one consistent URL pattern」「Related installable integrations: Figma plugin … VS Code extension … Raycast … MCP server: @thesvg/mcp-server on npm」
